text.tspan: Shown is the median income or consumption per day, as measured by 2021 vs. 2017 international-$. We see
several low-income countries above the 45-degree line: these countries are slightly better off, on the new 2021
Median (2017 prices) (international-$ in 2017 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Median (2021 prices) (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Data source: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2025)
Note: Where data for 2023 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2018 and 2026 is shown instead.
